scenes.aiSummary: The party plans its pace, tracks, provisions, and animal bait before leaving the evacuating town.

scenes.locationDetail: Plains north of Karawa and the ancient trade road
scenes.aiSummary: The party follows the attackers’ tracks north alongside the distant evacuation column.

scenes.locationDetail: Abandoned feeding and sleeping place north of the trade road
scenes.aiSummary: Tracks divide northwest and northeast; the party chooses Raven’s Hold despite concern for the evacuees.

scenes.locationDetail: Cross-country route northeast toward Raven’s Hold
scenes.aiSummary: The party rides northeast by dead reckoning rather than detouring to the road.

scenes.locationDetail: First night’s camp north of Karawa
scenes.aiSummary: Riswynn shares her uncle’s maps while the party considers the dwarven escape route and other approaches to Raven’s Hold.
Hard riding follows scattered kills through empty grazing country, with nervous antelope and no people.

scenes.locationDetail: Approaching the road to Raven’s Hold
scenes.aiSummary: A dust cloud prompts cautious scouting, a spyglass purchase clarification, and the discovery of wounded herders approaching with goats.
Shani describes gnoll attacks, evacuation rumors, and a stationary storm; Seeker heals a herder before the travelers continue south.

scenes.locationDetail: Road north along Dunmar’s old magical border
scenes.aiSummary: The party follows the road seeking the attackers, passing unsettling sights and finding the countryside increasingly silent.

scenes.locationDetail: Camp among boulders beside the northbound road
scenes.aiSummary: The party makes camp and sets a watch in the unnaturally still landscape.
Six gnolls ambush the camp with barbed and poisoned arrows; the party fights from cover and kills the fleeing survivor.
The party inspects the gnolls, recognizes their tactical differences, and resumes its interrupted rest.
Seeker questions a hungry vulture about Raven’s Hold and the storm before the party renews its cautious approach.
The party sees the vast stationary storm and Raven’s Hold’s distant valley, then considers approaching along the mountain road.

scenes.locationDetail: Camp south of the mountain pass
scenes.aiSummary: A fleeting smell of sulfur and rotting flesh reaches camp before another quiet night.
A fast-moving centaur herd approaches from the Plaguelands while the party discusses centaur history and customs.

scenes.locationDetail: Camp near the foothills, surrounded by centaurs
scenes.aiSummary: Tharandros warns of poisoned water and planar tethers; the party persuades him to warn Karawa and seek its dreamwalking knowledge.

scenes.locationDetail: Last miles toward the mountain road and Raven’s Hold valley
scenes.aiSummary: The centaurs turn south as the party prepares to choose its final approach to Raven’s Hold.

entities.label: Seeker’s runic stone die
entities.aiSummary: Seeker displays a six-sided stone die and proposes using it to settle the party’s travel pace.

entities.label: Riswynn’s maps of Raven’s Hold
entities.aiSummary: Two maps drawn by Riswynn’s uncle guide discussion of the fortress, dwarven outpost, and possible escape-route entrance.

entities.label: Ander Charmheart
entities.aiSummary: The party recalls Ander’s limited exploration inside Raven’s Hold’s outer wall and his strange movement toward the earlier battle.

entities.label: Wellby’s spyglass
entities.aiSummary: Wellby and Kenzo arrange a 100-gold spyglass purchase, and Wellby uses its modest magnification to inspect approaching travelers.

entities.label: Shani
entities.aiSummary: A Dunmari goat herder fleeing with her family warns the party about gnolls and a vast stationary storm. She agrees to report their progress if she reaches Tokra.

entities.label: Herder with a broken arm
entities.aiSummary: An unnamed member of Shani’s traveling group lost his horse and suffered a broken arm in the attack. Seeker heals him, prompting gratitude and surprise.

entities.label: Book describing the maw creatures
entities.aiSummary: Riswynn recalls Seeker’s book identifying the maw creatures as coming from another world.

entities.label: Floating Disc Coin
entities.aiSummary: Seeker transforms the coin into a floating platter bearing rabbit bait during the gnoll ambush.

entities.label: Gnoll leader with poisoned arrows
entities.aiSummary: A gnoll archer uses poison and communicates with its companions during the camp ambush. After the attackers are defeated, the party notices its necklace of bloody goat knucklebones.

entities.label: Vulture questioned at breakfast
entities.aiSummary: A hungry vulture eats a fallen gnoll and answers Seeker’s questions about movement near Raven’s Hold and flight near the storm.

entities.label: Cha’mutte
entities.aiSummary: Cha’mutte is discussed when recalling centaur participation in the war and distinguishing dragons from beings created through belief.

entities.label: Tharandros
entities.aiSummary: A centaur leader warns of spreading poisoned water, an Abyssal tether, and the party’s own planar connections. Persuaded by Karawa’s dreamwalking knowledge, he agrees to carry a warning south.

entities.label: Tharandros’s herd
entities.aiSummary: A migrating herd flees poisoned water from the east and changes course toward Karawa after its leader speaks with the party.

entities.label: Staff inscribed with Draconic runes
entities.aiSummary: Kenzo confirms that he still carries the found staff while correcting a confusion between Draconic and Drankorian.

entities.label: Mystai remaining in Karawa
entities.aiSummary: The party describes the mystai staying fortified in Karawa as a possible refuge and later directs Tharandros toward the people preserving its deeper magic.

interactions.aiSummary: Seeker displays his die and repeatedly proposes rolling it to determine the party’s travel pace.

quotes.text: So I thought we could solve the dispute using one of these. I hold up a stone cube with runic markings on each of the six sides. So here's my proposal. We assign Say, A rate of travel to each of the six numbers. Perhaps that's splitting it too finely, or we could choose between two: slow and fast regime. Or perhaps a compromise: we might choose between three paces, a kind of slow, fast, and, you might say, ordinary rate of travel. In that case, we could assign two numbers to each, roll the die, and then that way decide.

interactions.aiSummary: Riswynn shares her uncle’s two maps as the party discusses the fortress layout and possible routes into the dwarven outpost.

quotes.text: Well, since you are a cartographer, and that sparked my memory, I realized I haven’t shown you the maps that I—that my uncle drew. And they don't create any landmarks for me to follow, but perhaps with your slight familiarity with the region, something could come to mind.

interactions.aiSummary: The party recalls that Ander passed the outer wall but did not reach the fort.
Wellby and Kenzo arrange the cost of a basic spyglass and use it to examine the approaching herders.

interactions.aiSummary: Seeker proposes numbering the alternative plans for approaching the distant travelers.
Seeker recalls Ander walking toward the previous battle while the party considers whether creatures can draw prey after them.
The party exchanges warnings with Shani, learns about her family’s flight and the stationary storm, and asks her to report their journey to Tokra.

interactions.aiSummary: Riswynn recalls the book’s account of extraplanar maws while speculating about the storm.
Kenzo tells Shani that mystai remain fortified at Karawa’s temple and may provide safety or provisions.
Seeker uses the floating disc to offer rabbit bait, briefly distracting a gnoll as the disc follows him through the fight.

interactions.aiSummary: The party fights the poisoned-arrow archer among the six gnolls attacking their camp.
Inspecting the attackers reveals the apparent leader’s fresh goat-knucklebone necklace and greater tactical skill.

interactions.aiSummary: Seeker feeds and questions a vulture, learning of movement without food near the fortress and its inability to fly at the storm.

interactions.aiSummary: Wellby uses the spyglass to inspect the approaching centaur herd.
The party recalls centaur opposition to Cha’mutte and distinguishes his draconic nature from belief-created planes.
Tharandros explains poisoned waters and planar connections, then agrees to carry the party’s warning to Karawa after learning of its dreamwalkers.

interactions.aiSummary: The party meets the fleeing herd and persuades its leader to redirect the group south toward Karawa.

interactions.aiSummary: Kenzo confirms that he is carrying the found staff with Draconic runes while clarifying which language he is speaking.
The party describes Karawa’s remaining sages and dreamwalkers to persuade Tharandros to carry them news of the poisoned water.
